feature1.prompt: The issue arises because when using lambdify with modules='mpmath', rational numbers are not wrapped in the appropriate mpmath format, which leads to reduced precision in numerical evaluations such as those performed by nsolve. The goal is to enhance the MpmathPrinter so that it converts Rational numbers into a format that uses mpmath.mpf for both the numerator and denominator. For example, an expression like 232/3 should be represented as mpmath.mpf(232)/mpmath.mpf(3) to ensure full precision arithmetic. This change is targeted at addressing the precision loss reported when handling rational inputs in numerical routines.
feature1.hint_texts: Focus on implementing the _print_Rational method within the MpmathPrinter. The implementation should use string formatting to wrap the numerator and denominator with mpmath.mpf, following the pattern: '{0}({1})/{0}({2})'. Make sure the new method integrates well with the existing printing framework so that it is called whenever a Rational is encountered. This modification is isolated to the file sympy/printing/pycode.py.
feature1.entrypoint: File: sympy/printing/pycode.py; Function to modify: _print_Rational in the MpmathPrinter class (starting near line 332).

tests.FAIL_TO_PASS: No automated tests are provided for this part; manual verification of the printed output is expected.
tests.PASS_TO_PASS: Existing printer tests (for PythonCodePrinter, NumPyPrinter, SciPyPrinter, etc.) remain unaffected and continue to pass.

feature2.entrypoint: Files to modify: sympy/printing/tests/test_pycode.py and sympy/solvers/tests/test_numeric.py. Add new test functions to check the MpmathPrinter’s handling of Rational numbers and to ensure that nsolve evaluates rational expressions with high precision.
